compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.32 adds six animation-oriented lint/check rules, capture-stall recovery, runtime-media-source probing, nested media start-coordinate normalization, fractional final-frame preservation, safer media staging, and additional Studio/player hardening. reCast independently preserves deterministic frame/time rendering and bounded render validation, but does not expose the upstream lint/check, local Studio preview server, or player implementation surfaces, so those internal diagnostics are not copied.

HyperFrames v0.8.32 rejects unsupported encoder/rate combinations and isolates verification seeks. reCast continues to validate deterministic frame counts and artifact duration independently; unsupported upstream encoder-specific CLI behavior is not exposed by the current reCast CLI.

HyperFrames v0.8.33 changes static-frame deduplication so timelines with onUpdate-driven motion are excluded from static prediction and callback-driven motion remains visible during verification seeks. This is directly relevant to deterministic rendering semantics. reCast does not currently implement static-frame prediction/deduplication or an onUpdate timeline abstraction, so no speculative compatibility API was added.

HyperFrames main after v0.8.31 also adds a registry/catalog family of image-carousel blocks and optional hosted asset URLs. reCast does not currently expose a registry/catalog installer or catalog payload format, so these additions are recorded as upstream behavior rather than copied into an unsupported surface.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
